features.feature_value: Removed content that seemed to call for violence; supported moderation for violence calls despite free-speech orientation.
features.evidence_span: "The only post I selected to remove was one that seemed to call for violence."
features.rationale: The reflection explicitly ties the removal decision to perceived calls for violence.

features.feature_value: Cursing and explicit hatred made them more likely to not allow both posts; they would restrict when too explicit/hatred-heavy.
features.evidence_span: "I was influenced if there was cursing in the posts."
features.rationale: They describe cursing and perceived excess hatred/explicitness as the influence on keeping/removing.

features.feature_value: Foul language led them to view posts as childish/rude and thus more removable; preference for respectful language.
features.evidence_span: "Once foul language is used, it really becomes very childish and rude."
features.rationale: The participant links foul language to a negative tone judgment that drove their decision.

features.feature_value: Removed posts with mudslinging/cursing/distasteful comments that detract from meaningful political discussion; otherwise allowed strongly worded comments.
features.evidence_span: "intention of this platform is a place to have meaningful discussion about politics."
features.rationale: They specify a criterion based on maintaining meaningful political discussion versus allowing other strong wording.

features.feature_value: Focused on fairness/defensibility of views without slinging statements; influenced by whether debates were conducted respectfully.
features.evidence_span: "fairness of being able to defend their views without slinging statements"
features.rationale: Their reflection centers the decision on fair expression without antagonistic slinging.

features.feature_value: Recognized both prompts were essentially saying the same thing; resisted removing one purely due to political disagreement to preserve fairness.
features.evidence_span: "it wouldn't be fair to delete a post purely because I disagree with the political standpoint."
features.rationale: They describe using a step back and comparing standpoints to prevent bias from political preference.

features.feature_value: Used a neutral lens and focused on whether content could be misconstrued as a call to violence or racist.
features.evidence_span: "I based my decisions on if the post(s) said anything that could be misconstrued as a call to violence or racist."
features.rationale: They explicitly state the checks/conditions used to guide decisions.
